THE TRAILS PUBLIC IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT 
REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS 
 
Board Members 
Mark Motsko, Chair 
Tom Menicucci, Clerk 
Donna Sandoval, Treasurer 
Joseph Griego 
Jennifer Turner 
 
July 25, 2025 
11:00 a.m. 
 
Dept. of Municipal Development Conference Room 
Room S7400, 7th Floor 
Albuquerque Government Center 
One Civic Plaza, NW 
Albuquerque, New Mexico 
 
1. 
Call to order and roll call 
 
2. 
Approval of agenda 
 
3. 
Approval of Minutes of May 16, 2025 meeting of Board of Directors 
 
4. 
Trustee’s Report 
 
5. 
Treasurer’s report 
 
6. 
Consideration of Resolution 2025-03 ratifying actions at the May 17, 2025 Board 
where a quorum of Board members was not present: 
a. Ratification of the executed Agreement for Consulting Services with DTA 
b. Ratification of FY 2024-25 audit contract with Moss Adams LLP/Baker Tilly and 
authorization of Brescia Consulting LLC to access the State Audit Portal  
c. Authorization of DTA to access Local Government Budget Management System 
for FY 2025-26 
f. Ratification of Audit Resolution 2024-03  
g. Resolution 2025-01 establishing Open Meetings Policy 
h. Resolution 2025-02 approving Financial Statements FY 2023-24 
i. Consideration/Approval of FY 24-25 First, Second and Third Quarterly Financial 
Reports 
j. Consideration/Approval of Preliminary Budget FY 2025-26 
 
7. 
Consideration of Resolution 2025-04 approving a contract amendment for Brescia 
Consulting, LLC  
 
8. 
Consideration of Resolution 2025-05 approving a Records Retention Policy 
 
9. 
Consideration of Resolution 2025-06 approving the Fourth Quarterly Financial Report 
 

 
173341299.1 
10. 
Consideration of Resolution 2025-07 approving the Final Budget Fiscal Year 2025-26 
a. Public Hearing on the Portion of the FY 2025-26 Annual Statements and Estimates 
Not Relating to Debt Service on Special Levy Bonds (NMSA 5-11-23(F)) 
11. 
Consideration of Resolution 2025-08 approving a Budget Adjustment Request for 
Fiscal Year 2024-25 
 
12. 
Discussion regarding scheduling of next Board meeting. 
 
13. 
Other business 
 
14. 
Adjournment 
 
15. 
BOKF Authorized Representative Form to be executed with wet signatures; approved 
resolutions to be executed via Adobe Sign 
 
NOTICE TO PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES: If you have a disability and require special 
assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the District Clerk at the Albuquerque City 
Council Offices, Ninth Floor, Albuquerque Government Center as soon as possible before the 
meeting date at 505-768-3100.  Those in need of hearing assistance may call 711.  Public 
documents, including the agenda and minutes, can be provided in various accessible formats. 
Please contact the District Clerk at the Albuquerque City Council Offices if a certain type of 
accessible format is needed.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS 
 
May 16, 2025 
10:00 a.m. 
 
Department of Municipal Development Conference Room 
Room S7400, 7th Floor 
City of Albuquerque Government Center 
One Civic Plaza, NW 
Albuquerque, New Mexico 
1. 
Call to order and roll call 
 
2. 
Nomination and election of board member to serve as Chair of the District 
 
3. 
Approval of agenda 
 
4. 
Approval of minutes of July 25, 2024 
 
5. 
Trustee’s Report 
 
6. 
Treasurer’s Report 
a. Ratification of the executed Agreement for Consulting Services with DTA 
b. Discussion of Series 2024 Semi-Annual Report FY 2023-24 dated March 1, 2025 
c. Ratification of FY 2024-25 audit contract with Moss Adams LLP/Baker Tilly and 
authorization of Brescia Consulting LLC to access the State Audit Portal  
d. Authorization of DTA to access Local Government Budget Management System 
for FY 2025-26 
e. Approval of Brescia Consulting LLC fee increase 
f. Ratification of Audit Resolution 2024-03 (missed being formally adopted last July after 
Kory Hoggan’s presentation) 
 
7. 
Consideration of Resolution No. 2025-01 establishing Open Meetings Policy 
 
8. 
Consideration of Resolution No. 2025-02 approving Financial Statements FY 2023-24 
a. Presentation of FY 2023-24 audits by Moss Adams LLP 
 
9. 
Consideration of Fiscal Year 2024-25 First, Second and Third Quarterly Financial Reports 
 
10. 
Consideration of the Preliminary Budget Fiscal Year 2025-26 
 
11. 
Discussion regarding scheduling of next Board meeting 
 
12. 
Other business 
 
13. 
Adjournment 
 
14. 
Approved resolutions to be executed (via Adobe Sign)

THE TRAILS PUBLIC IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT 
BOARD OF DIRECTORS SPECIAL MEETING 
 
May 29, 2013 
2:30 p.m. 
 
Council Committee Room, Room 9081 
City-County Government Center, One Civic Plaza 
Albuquerque, New Mexico 
 
 
1. 
Call to order and roll call 
2. 
Approval of agenda 
3. 
Review of minutes of August 21, 2012 and February 15, 2013 meetings 
4. 
Consideration of Resolution 2013-01, approving Open Meetings Resolution  
5. 
Consideration of Resolution 2013-02, approving preliminary budget for Fiscal Year 2014 
6. 
Consideration of Resolution 2013-03, approving Quarterly Report to the Department of 
Finance and Administration  
7. 
Discussion of Disclosure Report, including special levy delinquencies 
8. 
Discussion of audit status 
9. 
Report on status of foreclosure proceedings 
10. 
Legislative update regarding House Bills 355 and 371 
11. 
Discussion regarding scheduling next Board meeting 
12. 
Other business 
13. 
Adjournment 
 
 
NOTICE TO PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES: If you have a disability and require 
special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Council Office as soon as 
possible before the meeting date at 768-3100 or by the TTY at 1-800-659-8331.

Albuquerque, New Mexico

Call to order and roll call

c. Authorization of DTA to access Local Government Budget Management System 
for FY 2026-27 
d. Budget Approval Letters from the Department of Finance and Administration for FY 
2024-25 and FY 2025-26 
 
6.

a. Presentation of FY 2024-25 audit by Baker Tilly US, LLP 
 
8. 
Consideration of Resolution No. 2026-03 ratifying FY 2025-26 First, Second and Third 
Quarterly Financial Reports 
 
9. 
Consideration of Resolution No. 2026-04 approving FY 2025-26 Budget Adjustment 
Request

Consideration of Resolution No. 2026-05 approving FY 2026-27 Preliminary Budget
